section_results.title: Determine Type of Change
section_results.original_content:
MOC Originator:
DETERMINE if the change meets the criteria for an Administrative MOC:
Drawing updates.
Organizational/Personnel Changes.
If an organizational change fits any of this criteria, an MOC is not required:
Does not impact the responsibilities described in the Integrity Management Plan (IMP), Completions Execution Plan (CEP) after construction begins, or Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Procedures.
Project team responsibility changes that occur after construction begins, with respect to Completions responsibilities refer to 01 91 11P Asset Commissioning Process.
HMI updates that impact only how an operator interacts with a system, but NOT the overall functionality.
Cavern Volume change no more than 1.5% change per year from last sonar.
Cavern Pressure change only as a result of effective casing seat change from an:
Updated sonar/gamma density log
Changing pressure gradient
Does NOT increase shutdowns past piping system MAOP
Software updates (e.g., firewall updates, operating system upgrade).
See Management of Change (MOC) Guidance for examples of software updates that require an MOC.
Does NOT include physical or process changes to operating/I&E equipment.
Other program or documentation changes that do NOT include a physical or process update (e.g., changes to the Integrity Management Program, High Consequence Areas (HCA), class locations, etc.).
For PHMSA 192-regulated steel transmission pipelines any changes to valves or components that have a:
Nominal diameter greater than 2 inches
Material yield strength of 42,000 psi (X42) or greater
Refer to 09.00.00.01 – Management of Change for all changes that do not meet this criteria.

section_results.title: Initiate AMOC
section_results.original_content:
MOC Originator:
INITIATE the Management of Change (MOC) in Maximo, completing all required fields.
In the Category field, select Administrative.
F09-004 (paper) may only be used in the event that the Maximo application is unavailable.
If using F09-004 (paper):
Obtain a unique MOC number.
COMPILE the MOC package.
ATTACH relevant documents to the MOC, including:
Redlined drawings
Redlined procedures
Other items, as needed
For CEP changes, ATTACH to the MOC:
Amended CEP
Any documentation that confirms delivery of corresponding information to project stakeholders affected by the change
DETERMINE required Pre-Modification Reviews and assign responsible parties for each.
Minimum reviews for every AMOC will be indicated or pre-populated on the F09-004 (paper) or F09-004A (Maximo app).
Add additional reviews based on the scope of the change, including reviews beyond the available Pre-Modification review list.
Evaluate key stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to be included in the change review process.
Refer to Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) Task Guidance for help choosing required pre-modification items/tasks.
A Hazard Screening Review (HSR) is NOT normally required in the Administrative MOC process, as this level of review is covered by the Operations and Personnel Safety Reviews.

section_results.title: Execute AMOC
section_results.original_content:
MOC Reviewer:
PERFORM assigned review per Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) Task Guidance.
Determine if any Post-Startup Checklist assignments are required for the MOC scope.
Communicate when additional Operating Requirements apply.
Indicate completion of review on the MOC.
NOTIFY the MOC Coordinator if:
The review process identifies that the change as is does NOT qualify for an AMOC and 09.00.00.01 – Management of Change must be followed.
Additional Pre-Modification Reviews must be completed prior to MOC Authorization.
The review process identifies modifications to the MOC that do NOT qualify for an AMOC.
The AMOC must be cancelled.
MOC Coordinator; Project Manager:
If a proposed change requires a full MOC (instead of an AMOC):
NOTIFY the MOC Originator
CHANGE the Category field to Major or Minor before continuing with the MOC process
REVIEW And assign any Post-Startup action items per 09.00.00.02 – Pre-Startup Safety Review.
Minimum required Post-Startup action items are:
Inform identified affected persons
Additional Post-Startup action items, as needed, based on the scope of the change
Completion of the Pre-Startup section of the PSSR form is NOT required for an AMOC
When all Pre-Modification Reviews are complete and Post-Startup action items are assigned:
SUBMIT the MOC package to the Manager, Operations for approval.
MAINTAIN supporting documentation for completed assignments with the MOC package.
Manager, Operations:
REVIEW the completeness of the MOC package, including:
Completed Pre-Modification Reviews
Attached supporting documentation
APPROVE, REJECT, or CANCEL the PSSR.
MOC Coordinator:
If completing a Permanent AMOC:
PROCEED to Section 4
If completing a Temporary AMOC:
DO NOT PROCEED past this step until ready to reverse the change or make it permanent.
To reverse the change:
CONDUCT a second PSSR
To make the change permanent:
CONDUCT a second AMOC
Once the related PSSR or MOC is in service:
PROCEED to Section 4
Refer to MOC Guidance for step-by-step instructions on reversing a change or making a change permanent.

sections.title: 1. Determine Type of Change
sections.content:
MOC Originator
:
DETERMINE
if the change meets the criteria for an Administrative MOC:
Drawing updates.
Organizational/Personnel Changes.
Project team responsibility changes that occur after construction begins, with respect to Completions responsibilities refer to
01 91 11P Asset Commissioning Process
.
HMI updates that impact only how an operator interacts with a system, but NOT the overall functionality.
Cavern Volume change no more than 1.5% change per year from last sonar.
Cavern Pressure change only as a result of effective casing seat change from an:
Does NOT increase shutdowns past piping system MAOP
Software updates (e.g., firewall updates, operating system upgrade).
Does NOT include physical or process changes to operating/I&E equipment.
Other program or documentation changes that do NOT include a physical or process update (e.g., changes to the Integrity Management Program, High Consequence Areas (HCA), class locations, etc.).
For PHMSA 192-regulated steel transmission pipelines any changes to valves or components that have a:
Refer to
09.00.00.01 – Management of Change
for all changes that do not meet this criteria.

sections.title: 2. Initiate AMOC
sections.content:
MOC Originator:
INITIATE
the Management of Change (MOC) in Maximo, completing all required fields.
In the Category field, select Administrative.
F09-004 (paper) may only be used in the event that the Maximo application is unavailable.
If using F09-004 (paper):
COMPILE
the
MOC package
.
ATTACH
relevant documents to the MOC, including:
For CEP changes,
ATTACH
to the MOC:
DETERMINE
required Pre-Modification Reviews and assign responsible parties for each.
Minimum reviews for every AMOC will be indicated or pre-populated on the F09-004 (paper) or F09-004A (Maximo app).
Evaluate key stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to be included in the change review process.
Refer to
Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) Task Guidance
for help choosing required pre-modification items/tasks.
A Hazard Screening Review (HSR) is
NOT
normally required in the Administrative MOC process, as this level of review is covered by the Operations and Personnel Safety Reviews.

sections.title: 3. Execute AMOC
sections.content:
MOC Reviewer
:
PERFORM
assigned review per
Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) Task Guidance
.
Determine if any Post-Startup Checklist assignments are required for the MOC scope.
Communicate when additional Operating Requirements apply.
Indicate completion of review on the MOC.
NOTIFY
the MOC Coordinator if:
The review process identifies that the change as is does
NOT
qualify for an AMOC and
09.00.00.01 – Management of Change
must be followed.
Additional Pre-Modification Reviews must be completed prior to MOC Authorization.
The review process identifies modifications to the MOC that do
NOT
qualify for an AMOC.
The AMOC must be cancelled.
MOC Coordinator
;
Project Manager
:
If a proposed change requires a full MOC (instead of an AMOC):
NOTIFY
the MOC Originator
CHANGE
the Category field to Major or Minor before continuing with the MOC process
REVIEW
And
assign any Post-Startup action items per
09.00.00.02 – Pre-Startup Safety Review
.

Completion of the Pre-Startup section of the PSSR form is
NOT
required for an AMOC
When all Pre-Modification Reviews are complete and Post-Startup action items are assigned:
SUBMIT
the MOC package to the Manager, Operations for approval.
MAINTAIN
supporting documentation for completed assignments with the MOC package.
Manager, Operations:
REVIEW
the completeness of the MOC package, including:
Completed Pre-Modification Reviews
Attached supporting documentation
APPROVE
,
REJECT
, or
CANCEL
the PSSR.
MOC Coordinator:
If completing a Permanent AMOC:
PROCEED
to Section 4

sections.title: 4. Close AMOC
sections.content:
MOC Coordinator; Project Manager:
VERIFY
completion of all Post-Startup action items per
09.00.00.02 – Pre-Startup Safety Review
.
ATTACH
supporting documentation to the MOC.
VERIFY
the MOC package is compiled and ready for closure.
Manager, Operations; MOC Coordinator:
APPROVE
or
REJECT
the AMOC for closure.
